description: OFCA, the executive arm of Hong Kong's Communications Authority, publishes about 40 datasets on the government open data portal. Statistics include key communications statistics, Hong Kong telecommunications indicators, key statistics on wireless, wireline and public WiFi services, internet service subscriptions, customer access via broadband networks and via the fixed network, mobile and fixed number portings, external telecommunications traffic by calendar and fiscal year, the use of international private leased circuits, and the capacity of external telecommunications facilities, with activated external capacity by country or territory. Registers list carrier, services-based operator and class licensees, internet service providers, broadcasting licensees and their channels, satellite master antenna television licensees, radio dealers and experimental stations, the public payphone register and radio applications. Technical tables cover the numbering plan, TV and analogue radio frequency tables, transmission modes and network coverage of TV licensees, HKCA specifications, and statistics on radio interference cases and radiation hazard measurements. Coverage: Hong Kong. Format and access: CSV files, mostly in English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, free under the DATA.GOV.HK terms with attribution. Caveats: many files were last refreshed in 2021 or 2022, while capacity, portings, payphones and radio applications were updated in 2026. Simulation uses: external capacity by destination for cross-border connectivity models, and subscription and traffic series for demand. Related records: the OFCA DTT coverage database and public WiFi locations are separate spatial datasets, and HKCERT incident statistics cover cyber incidents.
